facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Westwood, steps from UCLA and minutes from Rodeo Drive, Westfield Century City, Santa Monica beaches and West LA museums.
facts.excerpt: Stay in the heart of Westwood, steps from UCLA and minutes from Rodeo Drive, Westfield Century City, Santa Monica beaches, and West LA museums.

facts.text: The hotel is an urban retreat with personalized service, vibrant interiors and luxury amenities.
facts.excerpt: W Los Angeles West Beverly Hills welcomes hotel guests to an urban retreat with personalized service, vibrant interiors, and luxury amenities.

facts.text: The WET outdoor pool is heated.
facts.excerpt: take a dip in the heated WET® outdoor pool

facts.text: The WET Deck offers private cabanas, plush sectionals, alfresco dining and rotating DJs.
facts.excerpt: With private cabanas, plush sectionals, alfresco dining, and the electrifying beats of rotating DJs

facts.text: The EWOW Suite has a Cinema Room with immersive surround sound and city skyline views.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your movie nights in our state-of-the-art Cinema Room, featuring immersive surround sound and breathtaking city skyline views.

facts.text: The EWOW Suite has a living room, a movie room and a private bedroom and bathroom with a rain shower and dual vanities.
facts.excerpt: After unwinding in the living or movie room of your luxury Beverly Hills hotel suite, retreat to the private bedroom and bathroom, complete with a rain shower and dual vanities.

facts.text: Top-tier suites have deep soaking tubs.
facts.excerpt: Slip away to one of our top-tier suites and rejuvenate in one of our deep soaking tubs.

facts.text: The Whatever/Whenever service aims to get guests exactly what they want, whenever they want it.
facts.excerpt: Our renowned Whatever/Whenever® service is all about getting you exactly what you want, whenever you want it

facts.text: Beach House is a poolside restaurant set among palms and a waterfall, serving Baja-inspired plates and craft cocktails outdoors in the shade.
facts.excerpt: The restaurant is nestled amongst lush palms and a gentle waterfall where guests enjoy elevated Baja-inspired plates and craft cocktails in a relaxed, shaded outdoor setting.

facts.text: The Living Room Bar has high design, inventive cocktails and remixed rhythms.
facts.excerpt: with high design, inventive cocktails, and remixed rhythms.

facts.excerpt: Our P.A.W. program provides pet beds, food and water bowls, waste bags, and a variety of toys.
